items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: I was baptized and confirmed by Father Cuddy.

ctx.x: I was on Tulane across from the charity hospital. Yeah, I was baptized and confirmed by Father Cuddy. Uh-huh. And so, well, anyhow, Gilbert took me out in this place. It was in the year 1927 on the St. Joseph night. And I walked in there, and I had never seen nothing like that. They had a group in there called the Baby Dolls. They had a stocking full of $100 bills, and I was a perfect square. I never saw nothing like that in my life. And I just added up. And from that night on, I ain't never went back home.
What kind of a band was that?
